name: copilotprompts-self-awareness-review
title: Self-Awareness Review for Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
shortDescription: Private self-reflection coaching that reviews your own Teams meetings, chats, and sent emails to surface moments where you may have misread social signals or come across as passive-aggressive, curt, or dismissive.
longDescription: A private self-awareness coaching skill that reviews your own sent emails, Teams chat messages, and meeting transcript lines over a given week. It flags specific moments where you may have misread a social signal or come across as passive-aggressive, curt, sarcastic, or dismissive — showing the exact quote, how it likely landed, and a kinder rewrite. Copy the SKILL.md file into your repository's .github/skills/self-awareness-review/ folder to use it.
